question: In which year did the first Bengali woman writer Ashapoorna Devi win the Jnanpith Award?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1976.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ashapoorna Devi or Ashapurna Debi was a** prominent Indian novelist** and **poet in Bengali.**
 
• Ashapurna Devi was born in a BAIDIY family on** 8 January 1909** in** North Calcutta**, dead on **13 July 1995.**
 
• The Janpit Award is given for **outstanding contribution towards literature"**.
 
• The Janpit Award for The** novel Prothom Protishruti.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** About Janpit Award **

 
 
• ​Bharatiya Jnanpith is one of the **premier literary organizations** in India
 
• Jnanpith Award has achieved the recognition of the highest literary award in the country
 
• It the** established on 1961**
 
• First awarded on** 1965**
 
• Rewards **11th lakh**
 
• First awarded -**G Sankara Kurup**
 
• 2020 awarded**, Nilmani Phookan Jr**
